response.description: Microsoft SQL Agent Skills help you get more accurate, product-specific guidance when using AI agents to build, operate, and migrate SQL workloads. You can use these skills with Azure SQL Database, Azure SQL Database container, SQL Server to Azure migration, and Fabric Database Hub scenarios.The skills provide SQL-specific guidance that helps your AI agent work more effectively with Microsoft SQL technologies, making it easier to complete common development, migration, and management tasks.Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Microsoft SQL Agent Skills
